==Acquisition==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
*[[Factions]]
**[[Blade Ancient Syu-Shai]] ([[Raisu Palace (explorable area)]]) (requires a party member to be carrying a [[Proof of Triumph]])

Note that as a [[List of PvE-only skills|PvE-only]] skill, [[Elite Skill Tome|Elite Skill Tomes]] cannot be used to learn this skill.

==Notes==
*Since this skill does not target an ally, it will not remove conditions with [[Wielder's Remedy]].
*The created weapon spells are chosen randomly for each ally and cannot be a PvE-only weapon spell.
*The created weapon spells will have the same duration as Weapons of Three Forges (factoring in the Spawning Power bonus) and their attributes all match the original caster's Spawning Power rank.
**The created weapon spells will not list the correct duration in the effect window as a result.

==Trivia==
*This skill uses an altered version of the skill icon [[gw2:Conjure Flame Axe|Conjure Flame Axe]], an [[gw2:elementalist|elementalist]]'s skill in ''[[Guild Wars 2]]'' that gives the user and an ally a conjured weapon to use.
**The icon is the only one amongst all ritualist skill icons to have red and yellow colors. 
*''Triforge'' was the original name for the company now known as [[ArenaNet]].
*Added to the game with the [[Feedback:Game updates/20200422|22nd April 2020 update]] as part of the 15th [[Anniversary Celebration]].
